name: LanDeng Chinese Botanical Incense Ingredient Encyclopedia
description: Machine-readable definitions of the botanical ingredients in the LanDeng (澜灯) Chinese incense encyclopedia. Chinese terms are the source of truth; English is the agreed translation.

mainEntity.name: Agarwood
mainEntity.description: 沉香 (chénxiāng) is a Chinese botanical incense ingredient — Aquilaria spp. — with an aroma profile of woody, resinous, sweet, complex.

mainEntity.name: Benzoin
alternateName: Styrax tonkinensis (Siam); Styrax benzoin / S. paralleloneurus (Sumatra)

additionalProperty.name: Scientific name
additionalProperty.value: Styrax tonkinensis (Siam); Styrax benzoin / S. paralleloneurus (Sumatra)

mainEntity.name: Cedar

additionalProperty.name: Scientific name
additionalProperty.value: Cedrus spp. (true cedar); note 'cedarwood' often = Juniperus virginiana

mainEntity.name: Clove
